about: The sizes (bytes, gzipped, each file on its own) that tools/check-size.mjs holds every entry point to, plus the margin. A change that grows an entry beyond the margin fails until the increase is recorded with  pnpm check:size --record "why"  in the same commit; the history below says what grew, when and why. The ceiling for each entry is its budget in its package.json.
